@Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public record CompactionCompleteSummarizerProgress(Long durationMs, Long attemptCount, Long attemptAgeMs, Boolean attemptSettled, Long timeToFirstTokenMs, Long timeToFirstOutputMs, Long timeToFirstAnswerOutputMs, Long streamEventCount, Long outputEventCount, Long maxStreamEventGapMs, Long maxOutputGapBeforeAnswerMs, Long maxOutputGapAfterAnswerMs, Long idleMs, Long sinceLastOutputMs, Long answerChars, Long reasoningChars, Long inputTokensEstimate, Boolean inputShrunk) extends Record
